sources.role: official Windows/Wine distribution, path and input implementation
official downloads and supported host statement

paths.path: %APPDATA%\Cxbx-Reloaded\ (the emulator's user-data root; GUI settings and profiles are stored here).
Controller configuration is written by the Cxbx-Reloaded GUI into its user-data/configuration files; XInput/DirectInput gamepad bindings are selected through the controller settings UI.
paths.naming: No stable public controller-profile text grammar is documented; preserve the release-generated settings rather than guessing names.
Xbox title/save identifiers are directory names below Partition1/UDATA; files use the original Xbox save-container layout.

paths.path: No documented general-purpose Cxbx-Reloaded save-state facility or state-slot directory.
Cxbx-Reloaded uses HLE Xbox kernel/firmware components; it does not require a retail BIOS ROM file for ordinary XBE launches.
paths.naming: No universal external BIOS filename/checksum is published; EEPROM/HDD images are separate emulated storage, not BIOS.

paths.path: No external decryption key file is documented for Cxbx-Reloaded game launches.

linux.reason: Cxbx-Reloaded documents running its Windows binary under Wine, but no native Linux package is an official Cxbx runtime.

linux-flatpak.reason: No official Cxbx-Reloaded Flatpak package is identified.

macos.reason: The canonical project distributes Windows binaries; Wine on macOS is not a native macOS package capture.
